column-width.$description: The width of the content column: every block on a page (text, MediaText, quotes, lists) is this wide at most, centered, so all blocks share left and right edges. MediaBlock, Gallery, Grid, and the stacks can opt out with Width=wide.

wide-width.$description: The widest a page’s content gets: Sections and Containers span up to this width, and MediaBlock, Gallery, Grid, and stacks set to Width=wide fill it.

sm.$description: Minimum width of a Grid item before the row wraps, when Item width is sm (200px).

md.$description: Minimum width of a Grid item before the row wraps, when Item width is md (280px).

lg.$description: Minimum width of a Grid item before the row wraps, when Item width is lg (400px; 300px on Medium and Small).

xl.$description: Minimum width of a Grid item before the row wraps, when Item width is xl (600px; 400px on Medium and Small).

link-gap.$description: Space between the NavItems in MainNav, in a row on the page and in a column in NavOverlay.

logo-offset.$description: Bottom padding under the MainNav logo. Lifts the logo so its lowercase letters line up with the NavItem labels beside it.

logo-height.$description: Height of the Erin Tozour logo in MainNav: 32 on XL and Large, 24 on Medium and Small. Its width follows, so the logo keeps its proportions.

gap.$description: The least space between the logo and the NavItems in MainNav. The logo’s frame fills the rest, so the links sit at the end.

short-logo-width.$description: Below this width (MainNav’s content, inside its side padding), the logo shows only “erin,” so the NavItems still fit. The full logo + main-nav/gap + the three NavItems, rounded up: 212 + 32 + 374 on XL and Large, 159 + 24 + 358 on Medium and Small. On screens, the full logo shows from 624 wide on Medium, and “erin” from 560 to 623. Recompute if a nav label changes.

menu-width.$description: Below this width (MainNav’s content, inside its side padding), the NavItems move into NavOverlay, opened from the menu button. “erin” + main-nav/gap + the three NavItems, rounded up: 75 + 32 + 374 on XL and Large, 56 + 24 + 358 on Medium and Small. On screens, Small shows “erin” and the links from 488 wide, and the menu button below that. Recompute if a nav label changes.

padding.$description: Padding on all sides of a NavItem (its tap area).

gap.$description: Space between a NavItem icon and its label.

padding.$description: Padding on all sides of NavOverlay.

padding-x.$description: Left and right padding inside a Tooltip.

padding-y.$description: Top and bottom padding inside a Tooltip.

offset.$description: Gap between a tooltip and the element it describes. Leaves room for the focus ring.

marker-size.$description: Width and height of the marker before each UnorderedList item.

item-min-width.$description: Minimum width of a Gallery item before the Gallery stacks into one column (200px).

duration.$description: Time for the Skeleton pulse to go from its base color to its shine, and the same back, in milliseconds.

min-width.$description: Narrowest the Footer call to action gets before the links wrap below it: 300 on Large and XL (side by side), 320 on Medium and 240 on Small (stacked).

max-width.$description: Widest the Footer call to action gets, so its text keeps a comfortable line length (400px).

min-width.$description: Narrowest the Footer links area gets before it wraps below the call to action: 432 on Large and XL, just enough for the three link groups on one row with spacing/md between them; 480 on Medium and 240 on Small, which stack.

stack-width.$description: Below this width, a row MediaText stacks its text above its media (800px). Measured on MediaText itself, not the screen.

rotation.$description: Time for one full turn of the ThemeToggle star while hovered, in milliseconds.

blur.$description: Blur of the glow behind the ThemeToggle star.

scale-hover.$description: How much a PortfolioCard image grows inside its frame on hover, focus, and active. Code only (no Figma field takes a scale); Figma shows it by cropping the image to 105%.

text-max-width.$description: The widest PortfolioCard’s text gets in the brand gallery type, so the thumbnails get the rest.

stack-width.$description: Below this width, a small PortfolioCard stacks its image above its text; at or above it, they sit side by side (640px). Measured on the card itself, not the screen, like media-text/stack-width. In Figma, pick Layout=stacked or row to match the card’s width.

size.$description: Width and height of a NavCard (it’s square): 200, and 144 on Small so two overlapping cards fit a phone.

icon-size.$description: Width and height of the nav icon on a NavCard.

tilt.$description: How far a tilted NavCard turns at rest, in degrees (left or right by its Tilt property). It straightens on hover and focus. Code only.

gap.$description: Space between the NavCards in a NavCardGroup. Negative, so each card overlaps the one before it by 24px. Stored as the negative gap because Figma can’t bind a gap to a negated token.

text-min-width.$description: The narrowest a Hero’s text (Body) gets beside media: 460 on XL and Large, 300 on Medium, 200 on Small. When the text and the media don’t both fit, the media wraps under the text. Lowered (Nov 12) so the media sits beside the text in more cases: from 1388px on XL, 1116px on Large, and 768px on Medium.

media-width.$description: The widest a Hero’s media gets: 560 on XL, 320 on Large, 260 on Medium, 280 on Small, and never more than 100% of its space. A photo fills it (in Figma, set the Image’s width to this variable), and reel/size points to it, so a Reel is the same size. Smaller on Large and Medium so the media sits beside the text in more cases.

hold.$description: How long each image rests before the Reel turns, in milliseconds (2 s). Every image holds the same time.

dip.$description: The anticipation: the disc turns the wrong way (the card dips) before it turns, in milliseconds.

rise.$description: From the bottom of the dip to the top of the overshoot, on reel/easing/rise, in milliseconds. Only the curve up to its peak is used, so there’s no slow creep back.

fall.$description: From the top of the overshoot back through the resting spot to just below it (reel/angle/settle), in milliseconds.

settle.$description: From just below the resting spot up to rest, in milliseconds.

entrance-delay.$description: The entrance: the Reel opens on its last image, then this long after the page loads it turns once to the first, so a visitor scanning the page sees it move right away. Then the normal holds start. No entrance with reduce motion.

rise.$description: The rise curve, cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.78, 0.64, 1): a stronger overshoot than motion/easing/playful (1.56), for a whole disc turning. Only its first 52.5% is used, up to its peak, 17% past the target.

dip.$description: How far the disc turns the wrong way before it turns, in degrees. Code only.

settle.$description: How far the card sinks below its spot after the overshoot, in degrees. About a third of the overshoot, like a spring winding down. Code only.

tilt.$description: How much the cards turn with the disc: 1 is a rigid disc, 0 keeps them upright. Code only.

radius.$description: The disc’s radius, as a multiple of the card’s width. The pivot is to the right of the card, so cards arc up and to the right, and the next rises from below. Code only.

size.$description: Width and height of a Reel card (it’s square). Points to hero/media-width, so a Reel and a photo in a Hero are always the same size: 560, 320, 260, 280. In code it’s also at most 100% of its space.

scrim-opacity.$description: How dark a Reel card gets away from its resting spot: the page color (color/background/default) at this opacity over the card. 0 when it’s settled, rising to 0.7 by halfway between spots, so cards read as further back on the disc and never put a bright image behind a Hero’s headline. Code only.
